name: DHEM-EP
cond_layout: sw8[0:8] = [Newell, sin(clock), cos(clock), SYM-H, Pdyn, F10.7, AE, dipole tilt] (OMNI, z-scored with assets/conditions_joint_9_zscore_stats.npz) + SML[8:32]+SMU[32:56] (SuperMAG 24 MLT-sector lower/upper envelopes, z-scored with assets/conditions_joint_9_zscore_stats_SMU_SML.npz)

training.data: AMIE 1999, 2001-2002, 2004-2006 (1-min maps, 2,557,057 samples; potential channel, linear min-max to [-1,1])

notes: Trained with num_heads_upsample = 1; the paper results use the output-block self-attention with 4 heads (same weights), as set here. Raw weights, not EMA.
selection: checkpoint 240k, no selection. Paper statistics: 2003 test dataset (even 10-day blocks, scripts/split2003.py).
